questions.text: How many pedestrians were killed in NYC motor vehicle crashes each year from 2013 to 2025?
How are NYC crashes distributed across the days of the week, 2013 to 2025?
How do motorist and cyclist deaths compare year by year in NYC, 2013 to 2025?
Has road safety for pedestrians in Brooklyn gotten better since 2013? Make a chart suitable for a local news story and summarize the findings.
Are NYC's streets more dangerous at night? Make a chart and give a conclusion for a news report.
Did the risk of a motorist being killed per mile driven in NYC decline from 2013 to 2025? Make a chart and answer based on this crash data.
